verification_notes: c1b_quadratic confirmed present in the active-continuous ladder (Rung 1) -- not promoted.

c1c_systematic_interactions (active-continuous) and d1c_systematic_interactions (passive-continuous) are both skipped-by-design, with two independently-derived rationales (different evidence, different numbers), not one rationale copy-pasted across legs.
No gradient-boosting rung was ever attempted on the passive-continuous leg; d1_lognormal_glm (Rung 0) is never beaten.

p1e_gradient_boosting_calibrated's real current headline (post Prompt-86 coordinate-frame fix): PR-AUC 0.2267, ROC-AUC 0.8066. No CV-only calibration caveat exists for this rung anywhere in the corpus (checked); its actual caveat is a small n=259 unclassified-role slice.

x1 (active-xT Rung 0 comparator, corrected R2=0.11908) and x1c (active-xT Rung 2 promoted candidate, corrected R2=0.37407) are DIFFERENT rungs/metrics from the same Phase-5 refit table -- not two readings of the same rung. Same x1-vs-x1c pattern repeats as y1 (R2=0.12473) vs y1c (R2=0.33130) on the passive-xT leg.

active_binary.reference_model_status: promoted, coordinate-frame fix RECONFIRMED (mean fold-AP shift +0.0008, paired-t p=0.929, indistinguishable from zero); original Prompt-46 promotion stands, closed, not reopened.

rungs.name: v1_unweighted
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline. Held-out PR-AUC 0.372, ROC-AUC 0.819, ECE 0.011.

rungs.name: v1b_quadratic
rungs.note: Statistically real CV lift on 4 known U-shaped features (+0.0021 PR-AUC, p=0.0122) but does not clearly survive held-out (-0.0012 vs v1). Not promoted.

rungs.name: v1c_systematic_interactions
rungs.note: Promoted Prompt 43 (gain survives held-out, unlike Rung 1); later superseded by v1e_gradient_boosting_calibrated (Prompt 46).

rungs.name: v1d_random_forest
rungs.note: Beats v1c on PR-AUC (0.4085) but ECE 0.0183 is 1.8x worse (calibration). Explicitly 'a diagnostic rung, not a promotion candidate in its own right' -- no promotion audit run.

rungs.name: v1e_gradient_boosting_calibrated
rungs.note: Promoted Prompt 46, current standing reference model, superseding v1c. ROC-AUC 0.8364, Brier 0.0522, ECE 0.0096. Coordinate-fix RECONFIRMED unchanged (paired-t p=0.929).

active_continuous.label: Active - Continuous (E[xG|shot] hurdle component)
active_continuous.reference_model_status: promoted (Prompt 58), coordinate-frame fix REOPENED (metric moved outside noise, favourable direction) -- rung stands, headline numbers updated post-fix.

rungs.name: c1_lognormal_glm
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline. Held-out common log RMSE 0.9951, corrected R²=0.0371.

rungs.name: c1b_quadratic
rungs.note: Null result: 'does not beat c1 -- on either CV or held-out, on either the common-scale metric or original-scale MAE/R2.' Paired-t p=0.2073, Wilcoxon p=0.1875.

rungs.name: c1c_systematic_interactions
rungs.note: Not built. Two independent checks (shot-conditional interaction panel already 10/10 inconclusive; direct systematic interaction-expansion check found gains smaller than fold-to-fold noise, R2 0.047->0.055) both already answer the question this rung would ask. 'This is a closed decision for this leg, not deferred.'

rungs.name: c1d_random_forest
rungs.note: Promoted Prompt 58, current reference E[xg|shot] component, superseding c1_lognormal_glm. Post-Prompt-86-fix held-out common_log_rmse 0.9560 (pre-fix 0.9553), corrected R2 0.0978 (pre-fix 0.0925). Hurdle-pipeline readout: RMSE 0.04416, R2=0.1693.

rungs.name: c1e_gradient_boosting
rungs.note: Beats c1 baseline (p=0.0402) but loses to c1d (paired-t p=0.31, Wilcoxon p=0.44, mixed 2-of-5 folds). 'c1d_random_forest remains this leg's best regression candidate after Rung 3.'

passive_binary.label: Passive - Binary (P(shot within 10s))
passive_binary.reference_model_status: promoted (Prompt 52), coordinate-frame fix REOPENED (metric moved outside noise, favourable direction) -- rung stands, headline numbers updated post-fix (Prompt 86).

rungs.name: p1_unweighted
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline. Held-out PR-AUC 0.1736.

rungs.name: p1b_quadratic
rungs.note: Passes all 3 ladder gates and DOES survive held-out test (p=0.0104) -- the headline divergence from the active leg's v1b, which did not survive held-out. Not itself promoted (promotion audit deferred to Rung 4).

rungs.name: p1c_systematic_interactions
rungs.note: Passes all 3 gates (vs p1 p=0.0004, vs p1b p=0.00005); not itself promoted, superseded by later rungs.

rungs.name: p1d_random_forest
rungs.note: Mixed: passes gates 2 and 3 (vs Rung-0 baseline) but fails gate 1 (vs immediately-prior rung p1c, p=0.275, not significant).

rungs.name: p1e_gradient_boosting_calibrated
rungs.note: Promoted Prompt 52, current standing reference model. Post-Prompt-86 coordinate-fix headline: held-out PR-AUC 0.2267 (pre-fix 0.2162), ROC-AUC 0.8066 (pre-fix 0.7889). One caveat: p1c beats it on the small (n=259, 0.08% of held-out rows) defender_functional_role='unclassified' slice -- 'not disqualifying given its size.' No CV-only calibration caveat exists anywhere in the corpus for this rung; its reported numbers are held-out test numbers.

passive_continuous.label: Passive - Continuous (E[xG|shot] hurdle component)
passive_continuous.reference_model_status: Rung 0, never beaten by any later rung. Coordinate-frame fix RECONFIRMED (borderline, not significant at 0.05) -- original promotion stands, closed, not reopened.

rungs.name: d1_lognormal_glm
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline AND still the current reference model -- 'Rung 0, never beaten' (ALL_LEGS_SUMMARY.md #2). Held-out common log RMSE 1.0374, corrected R2=0.0078.

rungs.name: d1b_quadratic
rungs.note: 'An even more emphatic null result than the active leg's own Rung 1' (p=0.5013). Not promoted.

rungs.name: d1c_systematic_interactions
rungs.note: Not built. Plain additive linear regression already scores negative mean CV R2 (-0.0042); full pairwise-interaction expansion (406 cols) scores -0.0249/-0.0230, worse than plain linear. 'This is a closed decision for this leg, not deferred.' (An independently-derived rationale from c1c's, not a copy-paste.)

rungs.name: d1d_random_forest
rungs.note: Fails significance gate vs d1 (paired-t p=0.576) -- 'the third independent null result on this leg.' Directionally better held-out common log RMSE (1.0322 vs 1.0374) and corrected R2 nearly triples (0.0078->0.0211) but statistically inconclusive.

passive_continuous.note: No gradient-boosting rung was ever attempted for this leg -- verified by reading the full ladder doc, no LightGBM/GBM mention exists.

active_xt.label: Active - xT delta (threat change caused by the action)
active_xt.reference_model_status: promoted (Prompt 75), current reference model. Phase 5 of the coordinate-frame fix is a FRESH audit on the corrected target (not a before/after diff, since the xT target itself is directly frame-dependent) -- x1c remains promoted on the corrected data.
active_xt.coordinate_fix_verdict: fresh post-fix audit (target itself recomputed); x1c re-promoted

rungs.name: x1_two_stage_huber
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline/comparator (two-stage Huber classifier x regressor). Pre-fix held-out R2=0.1519; post-Prompt-86-fix corrected refit R2=0.11908 (also below its own pre-fix number, since the comparator's features/target both changed).

rungs.name: x1b_quadratic
rungs.note: Does not clear the bar to replace x1 as standing baseline; the rung's motivating question (tail-calibration gap) is 'unchanged to worse.'

rungs.name: x1c_random_forest
rungs.note: Promoted Prompt 75, current reference model, superseding x1_two_stage_huber. Ladder-gate pre-fix held-out R2=0.44947 (p=0.00006 vs x1). Post-Prompt-86-fix fresh audit (target itself corrected): held-out RMSE 0.04630, R2=0.37407 -- lower than the pre-fix 0.44947, but the report frames this as 'a correction, not a regression' since some of the old apparent accuracy came from the model and the frame-corrupted target sharing correlated errors.

rungs.name: x1d_gradient_boosting
rungs.note: Genuine mixed result: beats x1c on RMSE/R2/MAE (small, p=0.0031) but Spearman regresses (-0.0255) and the tail-calibration gap x1c closed widens back 2-5x. 'x1c_random_forest remains the leg's standing baseline.'

passive_xt.label: Passive - xT delta (threat change caused by the positioning)
passive_xt.reference_model_status: promoted (Prompt 78 ladder-gate, Prompt 80A full promotion), current reference model. Phase 5 fresh audit on corrected target -- re-promoted.
passive_xt.coordinate_fix_verdict: fresh post-fix audit (target itself recomputed); y1c re-promoted

rungs.name: y1_two_stage_huber
rungs.note: Rung 0 baseline/comparator. Pre-fix held-out R2=0.0612; post-Prompt-86-fix corrected refit R2=0.12473.

rungs.name: y1b_quadratic
rungs.note: Does not clear the bar -- the systematic positive prediction bias it targeted does not shrink (+0.00278 -> +0.00298, slightly worse). 'y1_two_stage_huber remains the standing baseline.'

rungs.name: y1c_random_forest
rungs.note: Promoted (Prompt 78 ladder-gate, Prompt 80A full promotion), current reference model, superseding y1_two_stage_huber. Prediction bias essentially eliminated (+0.00278 -> -0.000018). Pre-fix held-out R2=0.49325; post-Prompt-86-fix corrected refit RMSE 0.02418, R2=0.33130.

rungs.name: y1d_gradient_boosting
rungs.note: First rung on either xT leg to fail significance entirely vs the reference (paired-t p=0.0635, Wilcoxon p=0.125), Spearman regresses ~13%. 'y1c_random_forest remains the leg's standing baseline.'
